results.description:
The Entwined Lovers series brings the sizzling heat, irresistible passion, and spicy sensations you've been longing for.

Starlette Crown, the bold and passionate CEO of Platinum Pleasures, a highly successful online adult toy business, has built her empire from the ground up. But her life and work get derailed when her sister Stella mysteriously vanishes. Starlette finds herself thrust into her fantasy men. She's losing the battle of both her body and the intoxicating pull she feels towards two irresistible men.

Matthew Ellington and Derrick Knight, two driven private investigators with a shared obsession, have resigned themselves to finding the woman who could complete them. But when fate brings them Starlette, they realize she's the missing piece. Torn between professional duty and true love feelings, they must navigate their own emotions while searching for her sister and handle the stalker threatening to take away their forever.

An MMF Bisexual Menage Romance

**The books in this series feature polyamorous ménage relationships and can be read as standalones. Each book follows one triad with its own HEA.
